title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: The doner kebab at Durumzade was worth writing home about. We also ate at Istanbul Anatolian Cuisine, Jashn, Karakoy Sarihan Iskembe and Hanzade Terrace Restaurant.
Turkish food is easy to like because the flavour profile is familiar without being boring: grilled meats, bread, yoghurt, eggplant, stews and enough desserts to undo all the walking.
